name: Chemical Engineering
description: Chemical engineering programmes teach the design and operation of processes that transform materials at scale — reactors, separations, heat and mass transfer, process control and process safety. It is the engineering discipline built on chemistry, and the only one that requires organic chemistry. ⚠⚠ In Florida it is offered at only FOUR institutions in THREE cities, and two of those four share one joint college, so where you start matters more here than in any other engineering discipline.
degreesNote: The programme and the major are the same thing: a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, with master’s and doctoral degrees above it. Several programmes brand it chemical and biomolecular engineering, which is the same degree with a bioprocess emphasis. ⚠ ABET accreditation under the ENGINEERING commission is what employers screen on and what carries the four-year route to Professional Engineer licensure — verify the specific programme by name.

cips.note: Chemical Engineering — the degree itself. All Florida awards fall under 14.0701.

related.note: Treatment processes, reaction kinetics and mass transfer are chemical engineering subjects, which is why chemical graduates are hired into remediation and water treatment. ⚠ It is also the nearer degree geographically for many students: seven institutions award it against four for chemical.
Polymers, coatings, electrochemistry and semiconductor processing are the shared ground, and a materials master’s on a chemical bachelor’s is a standard combination.

Drug delivery, biomaterials and bioprocessing sit between the two. ⚠ If the pharmaceutical or device industry is the goal, read both before choosing — the chemical degree is the more transferable of the two at bachelor’s level.
